title: Loading Carried Where the Signed Request Behind a Booking Has Aged
content:
Where the signed request behind a booking on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts has been on the energy desk's register a long while, a loading goes onto the contracted price. The gallons standing to the member's credit decide how much.

**Where the signed request behind the booking has stood registered for at least 9 months and the gallons standing to the member's credit reach the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons**, the standing loading is 0.05 USD per gallon.

**Where that request has stood registered for at least 9 months and those gallons fall under the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons**, the standing loading is 0.02 USD per gallon.

**Where that request has stood registered for fewer than 9 months**, nothing is loaded onto the contracted price for the standing of the booking.

| Whole months the signed request has stood registered | Gallons standing to the member's credit | Standing loading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 9 or more | At or above the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | 0.05 USD per gallon |
| 9 or more | Below the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | 0.02 USD per gallon |
| Fewer than 9 | Either way | Nothing |

The months are counted from the day the request was lodged with the energy desk to the handling date, and the test is met at 9 months exactly.

*Hypothetical.* On a programme whose minimum pre-buy gallons stand at 1000, a request lodged 11 months before the handling date on an account with 1200.0 gallons standing to the member's credit carries a loading of 0.05 USD per gallon. The same request with 800.0 gallons standing carries 0.02 USD per gallon. A request lodged 8 months before the handling date carries nothing on either gallon figure.
